subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should maintainers require redacted real Gateway/provider outage proof before merging this memory-core recovery PR, or explicitly override the proof gate?
rationale: The patch looks correct from source review, but the contributor has only provided deterministic manager-level proof and explicitly lacks a live Gateway/Ollama outage run; the review contract blocks external PR merge readiness unless maintainers intentionally override that gap.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may accept the deterministic manager regression as sufficient and apply a proof override, owning the remaining live-provider risk.

options.title: Pause until refreshed
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until the branch is refreshed on current main and the proof question is resolved.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history signal across the memory manager/provider-state code that controls this fallback recovery path.
